# Semiconductor Annual Financial Comparison: NVDA, AMD, and INTC (2020-2025)

**Insufficient evidence**

NVDA revenue for the fiscal period ended 2025-01-26 was $130.497 billion [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html), up from $60.922 billion for 2024-01-28 [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html). NVDA net income for the fiscal period ended 2025-01-26 was $72.880 billion [Ebc64b283ab](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html), up from $29.760 billion for 2024-01-28 [E05bed4e2f8](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html).

## What was knowable then

As of the March 1, 2023 as-of date, historical annual reports established baseline figures for each company through fiscal year 2022. NVIDIA reported fiscal 2023 revenue of $26,974,000,000 and operating income of $4,224,000,000 for the period ending January 29, 2023 [E27fc4964d7](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581023000017/0001045810-23-000017-index.html) [Ec91c36e46f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581023000017/0001045810-23-000017-index.html). AMD reported fiscal 2022 revenue of $23,601,000,000 and operating income of $1,264,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2022 [E7c0de70da3](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/0000002488-23-000047-index.html) [Ea8789b8551](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248823000047/0000002488-23-000047-index.html). Intel reported fiscal 2022 revenue of $63,054,000,000 and operating income of $2,334,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2022 [Edefd1682e4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/0000050863-23-000006-index.html) [E15762d9638](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/0000050863-23-000006-index.html). Management disclosures from all three companies flagged macroeconomic uncertainty and channel inventory corrections entering 2023 [Ef19157ab6f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581022000147/nvda-20220731.htm) [E9c05ffeeea](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm) [E294075c419](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm).

## What happened later

Subsequent annual filings through March 2025 showed divergent trajectories. NVIDIA's revenue surged to $60,922,000,000 for the period ending January 28, 2024, and $130,497,000,000 for the period ending January 26, 2025, with operating incomes of $32,972,000,000 and $81,453,000,000, respectively [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E8c58b8d2cd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [Edfa0a58d57](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD's revenue shifted to $22,680,000,000 for the period ending December 30, 2023, before rising to $25,785,000,000 for the period ending December 28, 2024, alongside operating incomes of $401,000,000 and $1,900,000,000 [Ed422eea5f5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [E2e09a06900](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [E40807037c2](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000012/0000002488-24-000012-index.html) [Eaca1b81d9d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel's revenue declined to $54,228,000,000 for the period ending December 30, 2023, and $53,101,000,000 for the period ending December 28, 2024, with operating income of $93,000,000 in 2023 and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 in 2024 [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [Ee7da324732](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E58906c3289](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html).

## The peer test

Comparing the latest available annual results through March 2025 across differing fiscal calendars highlights divergent performance. NVIDIA's fiscal year ended 2025-01-26, reporting revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [Edfa0a58d57](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html). AMD's fiscal year ended 2024-12-28, reporting revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 [E2e09a06900](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html) [Eaca1b81d9d](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248825000012/0000002488-25-000012-index.html). Intel's fiscal year ended 2024-12-28, reporting revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html) [E58906c3289](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Profit directions diverged, as NVIDIA and AMD expanded operating income while Intel incurred an operating loss.

## Cross-examination

Management statements prior to March 1, 2023, anticipated challenging market environments and inventory adjustments rather than issuing deterministic multi-year revenue targets [E294075c419](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm) [E9c05ffeeea](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086323000006/intc-20221231.htm). Observed outcomes cannot verify unstated guidance, but empirical filings validate the cited historical figures and subsequent divergence [E1d1ed85017](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581024000029/0001045810-24-000029-index.html) [E47912effca](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581025000023/0001045810-25-000023-index.html) [E7a1493ba18](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086324000010/0000050863-24-000010-index.html) [E9825b28a5f](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/50863/000005086325000009/0000050863-25-000009-index.html). Forward-looking risk warnings were noted by management, yet neither outcome was explicitly quantified as a management promise [Ec4634c41c4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581022000166/nvda-20221030.htm). An investor should ask: What specific enterprise segment margins and pricing assumptions underpin management's current outlook for the upcoming fiscal year?

## Limits

- As-of vintages for macroeconomic data are absent, and specific multi-year forward revenue guidance targets were not provided by management prior to the March 1, 2023 viewpoint.
- The financial comparison may be informative, but no retrieved management claim was linked to testable outcomes. The overall claim verdict is therefore insufficient evidence.

NVIDIA's revenue surged to $60,922,000,000 for the period ending January 28, 2024, and $130,497,000,000 for the period ending January 26, 2025, with operating incomes of $32,972,000,000 and $81,453,000,000, respectively [E1d1ed85017] [E47912effca] [E8c58b8d2cd] [Edfa0a58d57]. AMD's revenue shifted to $22,680,000,000 for the period ending December 30, 2023, before rising to $25,785,000,000 for the period ending December 28, 2024, alongside operating incomes of $401,000,000 and $1,900,000,000 [Ed422eea5f5] [E2e09a06900] [E40807037c2] [Eaca1b81d9d]. Intel's revenue declined to $54,228,000,000 for the period ending December 30, 2023, and $53,101,000,000 for the period ending December 28, 2024, with operating income of $93,000,000 in 2023 and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 in 2024 [E7a1493ba18] [E9825b28a5f] [Ee7da324732] [E58906c3289].

sections.title: The peer test
sections.text: Comparing the latest available annual results through March 2025 across differing fiscal calendars highlights divergent performance. NVIDIA's fiscal year ended 2025-01-26, reporting revenue of $130,497,000,000 and operating income of $81,453,000,000 [E47912effca] [Edfa0a58d57]. AMD's fiscal year ended 2024-12-28, reporting revenue of $25,785,000,000 and operating income of $1,900,000,000 [E2e09a06900] [Eaca1b81d9d]. Intel's fiscal year ended 2024-12-28, reporting revenue of $53,101,000,000 and an operating loss of $11,678,000,000 [E9825b28a5f] [E58906c3289]. Profit directions diverged, as NVIDIA and AMD expanded operating income while Intel incurred an operating loss.

sections.title: Cross-examination
sections.text: Management statements prior to March 1, 2023, anticipated challenging market environments and inventory adjustments rather than issuing deterministic multi-year revenue targets [E294075c419] [E9c05ffeeea]. Observed outcomes cannot verify unstated guidance, but empirical filings validate the cited historical figures and subsequent divergence [E1d1ed85017] [E47912effca] [E7a1493ba18] [E9825b28a5f]. Forward-looking risk warnings were noted by management, yet neither outcome was explicitly quantified as a management promise [Ec4634c41c4]. An investor should ask: What specific enterprise segment margins and pricing assumptions underpin management's current outlook for the upcoming fiscal year?
